title: Space bound persists after halting
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over an alphabet $\Sigma$, let $x,w$ be words over $\Sigma$, and let $t,s$ be natural numbers. If $M$ computes $w$ from $x$ within $t$ steps and has used at most $s$ work-tape cells through step $t$, then for every natural number $t'$, the total number of work-tape cells visited through step $t'$ is at most $s$.
hypotheses_covered: space used through step $t$ is at most $s$
